body: U+0023# 2026-09-30: post-merge verification, 10.17 on the Note10+, 3.48 glyph checkU+000AU+000AThe owner merged #245 into mitosis/toolchain, then #244 and #246 into main. Main is 8aa7fd0.U+000AU+000AU+002A*Verification.**U+000AU+002D Main's tree matches the swept code except the five test-build id files.U+000AU+002D On pristine main, all 30 test folders pass, `test/impeller` passes on both engines, and analyze is clean.U+000AU+002D No CI runs on main; both workflows are pull-request only.U+000AU+000AU+002A*Clean-up.**U+000AU+002D Removed: the mitosis run worktrees; the branches impeller-base, mitosis/toolchain, mitosis/meadow-impeller, mitosis/small-fixes and mitosis/meadow-rays (all in main first); the kit worktrees meadow-bench, sweep-347 and main-348; apps/sweep-347.U+000AU+002D Restored: work/manual's pubspec.lock. That worktree predates this session and was otherwise left as it was.U+000AU+002D The owner's checkout was fast-forwarded to 8aa7fd0; their local edits are untouched.U+000AU+002D New id patch: `patches/plain-build-8aa7fd0.patch`.U+000AU+002D Memory: the renderer note was updated to say macOS is on Impeller.U+000AU+000AU+002A*Manual-test build for the owner.**U+000AU+002D `~/.mitosis/field-notes/testkit/apps/main-8aa7fd0/field_notes_plain.app`: release build, `dev.satanshumishra.fieldNotes.plain`, Impeller MetalSDF.U+000AU+002D Its journal is seeded with 2024 (366 days), 2025 and 2026 to date, plus the `loved` unknown-mood day.U+000AU+002D The original database is kept as `field_notes.sqlite.bak-2026-09-27`.U+000AU+000AU+002A*10.17 on the Note10+.**U+000AU+002D Bench APK `...mbench` built from 8aa7fd0, run with the aapt check, `-s RF8MA2NA3ZM`, then uninstalled. The real app was absent before and after.U+000AU+002D Three runs:U+000A  U+002D 60 fps held in 12 of 12 cases on every run.U+000A  U+002D Scene ready within 1 s in 12, 11 and 11 of 12 cases (worst 1.27 s, first case).U+000A  U+002D No frame over 100 ms in 10, 0 and 0 of 12 cases. Longest frames were 76–180 ms, and 646–660 ms in the first case.U+000A  U+002D Before the fix, on 3.47.5 pre-fix: 8 of 12 at 60 fps, scene ready 1.45–1.88 s, longest frame 315–640 ms.U+000AU+002D Timeline: steady-state raster never exceeds 41 ms. In each opening, four bakes of about 20 ms each run back to back on the raster thread, so one frame waits 80–100 ms. The first case also carries about 570 ms of one-time OpenGL ES pipeline setup per process.U+000AU+002D Likely source, inferred from the code and not labelled in the trace: the palette recolour in `meadow_layers.dart` around line 1098. It redraws the mountains image and every lake image in one call.U+000AU+002D Verdict: 10.17 is partly met. 60 fps and the 1 s opening hold; no frame over 100 ms does not.U+000AU+000AU+002A*Flutter 3.48 glyph check**, at the user's request relayed by the lab session.U+000AU+002D Both apps built from 8aa7fd0 with identical package versions; the 3.48 build used a separate Flutter worktree at 3.48.0-0.5.pre, which contains 1db664b8.U+000AU+002D Each ran in a fresh lab macOS VM with 16 screenshots at 10 s.U+000AU+002D Result: 6 of 12 Meadow frames garbled on 3.47.5; 0 of 12 on 3.48. Speed matched in 11 of 12 cases.U+000AU+002D Evidence is in `results/lab-2026-09-30/glyph-check/`, and the report is in `testkit/E2E-REPORT.md`.
